policy: Official picks use Hubáček gates: decorrelated model beats the de-vigged market by >= 2 pp, honest EV >= 2% (calibrated pre-decorrelation probability), and a per-bet-type confidence bar (20 pp moneyline, 10 pp baseball/soccer, 5 pp spread cover). Live thresholds live in web/hubacek_picks.py; per-league overrides (min_market_gap_pp, min_win_confidence_pp, min_ev_pct, ml_lo/ml_hi, allowed_sides, min_spread_cover_gap_pp, min_spread_confidence_pp, min_spread_point_edge) are stored here from walk-forward bet backtests.

mlb.note: MLB v2 (73 features: ISO/XBH, bullpen outs-5, SP FIP trend, elo momentum) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_mlb_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 6 pp (6.7 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -200..+200. Opening-line ROI +34.3% (2024-2026, CLV +21.8%); closing-line floor -2.2%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between those brackets.

nba.note: NBA v2 (77 features) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nba_bets.py): market-aware margin model (sigma 12.81) cover gap >= 8 pp and point cushion >= 3 at the opening spread. Opening-line ROI +22.8% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (2024-2026, 728 bets, worst-season +19.7%). Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

wnba.note: WNBA v2 (66 features; OOS LL 0.62462) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_wnba_bets.py): pure margin model cover probability vs the juice-implied break-even. Live gate kept at 8 pp cover gap with a 5 pp confidence floor (prior open-line +5.2% ROI / 321 bets). Retrain improved OOS logloss; morning bets sit between open and close.

cbb.note: Official tracking paused until a proper walk-forward validation lands before the 2026-27 season. A leakage-free CBB backtest needs date-stamped Torvik archives plus per-event historical odds that are not cached locally yet; gate parameters are kept in place for when the league re-enables.

nfl.note: Disabled by NFL walk-forward bet backtest (scripts/backtest_nfl_bets.py): nfelo margins vs nflverse closing spreads, 1999-2025 (6906 games; nflverse has no opening lines). No gate in the cover-gap 4-8 pp / point-edge 2-5 / EV 2-3% grid achieved positive worst-season ROI at the close — best worst-season config (7.5 pp / 2.0 pts) returned -1.29% ROI over 3368 bets (worst season -15.0%); best overall config (4.0 pp / 5.0 pts) returned +0.61% over 1188 bets but with a -19.9% worst season. The pure nfelo margin (MAE 10.69) does not beat the closing spread (MAE 10.25). Gate parameters kept for reference only.

cfb.note: Disabled by CFB walk-forward bet backtest (scripts/backtest_cfb_bets.py): production Elo margins vs ESPN consensus FBS spreads fetched by scripts/fetch_cfb_odds.py (2022-2025, 2549 games with a close, 1700 with an open). No gate in the cover-gap 4-8 pp / point-edge 2-5 / EV 2-3% grid achieved positive worst-season ROI — best at the close -1.27% ROI over 1747 bets (worst season -4.69%), best at the open -2.53% over 955 bets (worst -4.64%); an extended sweep topped out at -0.87% worst-season at the open. The pure Elo margin (MAE 14.15) does not beat the closing spread (MAE 12.11). Gate parameters kept for reference only.

nhl.note: NHL v2 (88 features: flurry/rebound xG, PP/PK ice, goalie HD GSAx, schedule density) walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_nhl_bets.py): raw model-market gap >= 7 pp (7.8 pp after 1.12x decorrelation), prices -350..+300. Opening-line ROI +9.4% with all 3 open-odds seasons positive (CLV +3.95%); closing-line 12-season ROI +6.1%. Bets recorded in the morning sit between the open and close.

epl.note: Soccer v2 pooled top-5 walk-forward backtest (scripts/backtest_soccer_bets.py): market-aware calibrated home prob beats the devigged opening line by >= 4 pp raw (4.6 pp after 1.15x decorrelation), EV >= 5% — home outcomes only (draw/away legs were not profitable). Best-price execution ROI +4.3% across 2015-2025 with 10/11 seasons positive, CLV +4.0% (65% positive-CLV bets).
